scenario.task:
Je veux demander un remplacement sous garantie pour mon téléphone Samsung qui ne charge plus

User Guide: The user speaks Canadian French. They explain their Samsung phone won't charge. They will verify their identity, confirm no physical damage, and complete the replacement request If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
